observed_readiness_prefix.fallback_skip_basis: Captured AL1 followed by exact next conditional; no separate post-jump observation

placement_query_effects.diplomacy: Existing blocked-entry vector, open-borders array, alliance/permanent/war symmetric relationship reads; no diplomatic mutation
placement_query_effects.embark: Existing Unit pass vector and tech/civic definition iteration with already-owned prerequisite flags; no unlock mutation
placement_query_effects.district: Definition hitpoints, existing strength statistics and fixedpoint caller-stack results; native city-attribute sparse lookup returns existing index or0

readiness.move: Self member readiness; when formation count>=2 check each existing other member in native order
readiness.member: Null member returns true; otherwise !delayedDeath && CanMove && !pending && activityAWAKE && automate=-1 && !busy
readiness.cycle: Invalid location/delayedDeath/noFormation returns true; NeedsAttention or HasAdjacentMove returns false; otherwise command then operation HoldCycling

readiness.actual_hold_cycling_reachability_proven: Skipped for one captured old-empty AWAKE call; not a complete callback census
